name: User Profile and Handle Model
description: Define the user profile: display name, handle, avatar, bio, links. Handles are unique within a cell. Profile is the public-facing identity presentation for a principal.
purpose: Provide a consistent, portable user profile model that works across cells and federated instances.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile schema defined: displayName, handle, avatar (URL or data URI), bio, links array
Handle uniqueness enforced within a cell — case-insensitive
Handle change flow with cooldown period to prevent squatting cycling
Avatar handled as content-addressed blob with size limits
Profile visibility model: public, members-only, private fields
Profile exportable in portable format for federation and account export
